oracles.tool: circleci config process and CircleCI vendor textDocument/references

notes: CircleCI-Public/cimg-node: T-R7/P-T1: vendor CircleCI YAML language server 0.54.0, pinned by version/checksum, queries every command/executor declaration across all five canonical and three separate holdout configs. Every returned location is classified and all workflow executor parameter/matrix pairs enter recall truth. Same-name command/job defect: definition points to the job and references on the command also return its workflow job entry; the compiler adjudicates the command expansion, and the extra workflow entry is recorded as an oracle error. Two external orb uses remain unscored. Compiler cross-checks are required by the instrument for namespace errors. No extractor or parameter-matrix change. Small-cohort timing is non-informative; no dialect-wide throughput claim.
